c. 1250: the capital at Yin (Anyang). 'Yin served as the capital during the Late Shang period (c. 1250 – c. 1046 BCE)', 'the reigns of 12 Shang kings'; the move under Pan Geng ('Pan Geng moved the capital from Yān') is undated on both pages, so the Late Shang period's start is used.

c. 1046: King Wu of Zhou wins at Muye; the Shang fall. Infobox 'Battle of Muye: c. 1046 BC'; Di Xin 'is said to have committed suicide after his army was defeated by Wu of Zhou'; Nivison and Shaughnessy 'argue for an end date of 1045 BC'. certainty.note: A Bronze Age state known from archaeology and oracle bones: every edge is approximate; the Erligang outposts (Panlongcheng on the middle Yangtze, the Beijing area) are a cultural sphere, not territory.
